shared_elements: horizontal register or band of repeated geometric/ornamental motifs
justification: The main shared content is only broad: both include profile living figures and some horizontally organized repeated ornament or signs. The biggest difference is that A is a coherent horse-and-wheeled-chariot scene with harness and a floral border, while B is a stacked set of schematic signs, birds/animals, and anthropomorphic figures with no comparable vehicle scene or specific relationships.
